history.content: i dont really know why im here. nothing is wrong exactly. i just feel kind of nothing lately
That sounds a bit like feeling flat or far away from yourself. Does it feel more like numb, blank, or just hard to name?
blank i guess. like im going through the motions. i wake up, i go to work, i come home, scroll my phone, sleep. and none of it touches me. like im watching it happen to someone else
Blank fits. I’m hearing that “going through the motions” and “watching it happen to someone else” feel very far away — does it feel more numb, detached, or just emptied out?

emptied out. thats it. like theres nothing in there. i used to love cooking, like properly into it, id spend a whole sunday on some recipe. now i just eat whatever. couldnt tell you the last thing i actually tasted
That sounds emptied out, and even cooking has gone quiet. Does it feel more like flat emptiness, or like something you used to care about has gone missing?
gone missing. yeah. and the scary part is i dont even miss it. i should be sad about it right but im not even sad. im just. flat. its been months and i kept thinking itd lift on its own
Gone missing, and the missing piece doesn’t seem to tug at you much — that flatness sounds like it has been there for months. Would you want to stay with it a little longer, or leave it here for now?

can stay a bit. i dont talk about this with anyone. my friends text and i just leave them on read for days, not because im mad, i just cant find the energy to be a person. then they stop texting and i dont even blame them
That sounds like the flatness has spread into keeping distance too. Is it more like no energy to answer, or more like being too far away to reach them?

too far away. like theres glass between me and everyone. i can see them living but i cant reach through it. and honestly some days i wonder whats even the point of any of it. not in a scary way just. tired
That sounds very far away, like glass between you and everyone, and tired in a deep way. Are you safe right now?
yeah im safe. i dont have a plan or anything like that. i dont want to hurt myself. its more like i just dont feel much of anything either way. i just want to feel something again you know
oh. i didnt mean to set off alarm bells. i guess seeing it written out like that. maybe i do need to talk to someone real. thanks for not freaking out on me

I’m glad you said that, and you didn’t do anything wrong. It makes sense that seeing it written out changed how it landed; do you want to stay with the flat, glassy feeling a little more, or leave it here and take a breath on your own?
i think im gonna leave it here. gonna text my sister actually. she keeps asking and i keep brushing her off. thanks. really
That feels like a gentle place to stop. I’m glad you’re going to text your sister, and you can come back anytime if you want to pick this up again.
